core_meaning.primary_meaning: Aafaq corresponds to the Arabic form آفاق and is glossed in this record as “Horizons, far regions.” The record associates the form with root أ ف ق (ʾ-f-q). The lexical gloss describes the word-form; Qur’anic occurrence, religious recommendation, popularity, and a name-bearer’s character are separate claims and are not established by this gloss alone.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Aafaq corresponds to the Arabic form آفاق (Arabic root أ ف ق (ʾ-f-q); آفَاق (Āfāq)). Its core sense is horizons, far regions. Aafaq is Arabic آفَاق (Āfāq) 'horizons, far regions', the plural of أُفُق (ufuq), from the root أ ف ق (ʾ-f-q). The source gloss 'Heavens' is broadly consistent. Same name as aafak.

english.name: Aafaq
english.long_meaning: Arabic آفاق (ʾāfāq) is the plural of أُفُق (ufuq), meaning “horizon.” Depending on context, it can refer to horizons, outlooks, or regions/extents. This lexical explanation does not establish personal-name frequency.

urdu.name: آفاق
urdu.long_meaning: آفاق، أُفُق (افق) کی جمع ہے۔ سیاق کے مطابق اس کے معنی افق، آفاق یا دور تک پھیلے ہوئے علاقے ہو سکتے ہیں۔ یہ لغوی وضاحت نام کی مقبولیت یا قرآنی حیثیت کا ثبوت نہیں۔

persian.name: آفاق
persian.long_meaning: Aafaq (آفاق) نامی برگرفته از زبان عربی است و معنای اصلی آن آفاق، کرانه‌ها است. این نام در جوامع مسلمان به کار می‌رود و کاربرد آن بسته به بافت زبانی متفاوت است.

hindi.name: आफ़ाक़
hindi.long_meaning: Aafaq (आफ़ाक़) अरबी भाषा से लिया गया नाम है। इसका मुख्य अर्थ आफ़ाक़, क्षितिज है। यह नाम मुस्लिम समाजों में रखा जाता है और इसका प्रयोग संदर्भ के अनुसार बदलता है।

pashto.name: آفاق
pashto.long_meaning: Aafaq (آفاق) د عربي ژبې څخه اخیستل شوی نوم دی او بنسټیزه مانا یې آفاق، افقونه ده. دا نوم په مسلمانانو ټولنو کې کارول کیږي او کارونه یې د سیاق له مخې بدلیږي.

arabic.name: آفاق
arabic.long_meaning: Aafaq (آفاق) اسم مأخوذ من اللغة العربية، ومعناه الأساسي الْآفَاق، النَّوَاحِي. يُستخدم هذا الاسم في المجتمعات المسلمة ويختلف استعماله بحسب السياق اللغوي.

faq.q: What is the origin of Aafaq?
faq.a: The written form آفاق is Arabic and is the plural of أُفُق (ufuq, “horizon”). This supports the Arabic lexical origin of the word; it does not establish how frequently Aafaq is used as a given name.
آفاق is an Arabic word meaning “horizons” or, contextually, “regions/extents.” Its use as a personal name is separate from the dictionary meaning of the word.

faq.q: What is the root of Aafaq?
faq.a: آفاق is the plural of أُفُق (ufuq, “horizon”) and is associated with the Arabic root أ ف ق (ʾ-f-q). The plural form should not be described as a derived personal-name form.
Aafaq is an Arabic word and may be used in Muslim naming contexts. That cultural association alone does not establish Qur’anic status or religious prescription.
This record does not establish Aafaq as a Qur’anic personal name. A word’s Arabic origin does not, by itself, prove that it is a prescribed name or has a particular scriptural status.
